notes.title: Soulbound Legacy Launch - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone! 

Thank you once again for your incredible support![/h2][p]Finally, Introducing the Soulbound Legacy update. A final push from the original development team to update and polish Soulbound to the original vision![/p][p]It brings with it tons of new features, including achievements, updated visuals and Steam Remote Play, so you can finally cross souls with your friends online![/p][p]We’ll also be putting out some smaller bug fixes and tweaks in the near future, but this update squashes most of the known bugs from the original build.[/p][h2]
🌟 Key Features Added[/h2][h3]⏱️ New Visuals [/h3][p]We’ve refreshed the look of the game, updating some background visuals, character sprites and some animations, all with enhanced UI and effects, not to worry though, the classic visuals can still be found in survival mode for those of you who don't use dark mode![/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/f54197298859ebb91dba1aca558158fab2b765f4.png"][/img]🧾 Compendium[/h3][p]Browse through detailed lore, stats, and backstories for all Soulbound characters. Along with this is included key information regarding enemy type, health points as well as a difficulty rating on how hard they are to play. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/0e2aa6a1f93fa81dbadbeed62cadbc4961e53283.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎮 Remote Play Support[/h3][p]You can now play Soulbound Legacy with friends via Steam Remote Play.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/54af6ed98a955825730f07ba3f0d27a85d3329d3.png"][/img][/p][h3]🏆 Achievements[/h3][p]We’ve implemented 12 brand new Steam achievements to the game for you to show off your mastery![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/82e0e6b129189c3f95cb19168602bcce8c285357.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎯 Character Practice Ranges[/h3][p]Each character now has their own practice range to hone your skills before a match.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/647bc2615f431915552e49548b12a512eb2876e0.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎮 Full Controller Support / Steam Deck Verified [/h3][p]From menus to gameplay, controller support is now seamless on both PC and Steam Deck.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/0788db1b47bb313b4ca26b4163b314dd846da4c2.png"][/img] [/p][h3]❤️ Soulbound Legacy: Supporter Pack[/h3][p]Alongside this update we’re also announcing the Soulbound Legacy: Supporter Pack.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/5f1619c09b0db0b03337121a79cbea7a663d7457.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Supporter Pack will directly support the original Soulbound developers and includes tons of behind the scenes information about the development of Soulbound, and other cool digital goodies which shows everything it took to get here, including a development interview with Schmooving Studios![/p][p][/p][h2]➕ Additional Features / Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Score now displays in Survival mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for Linux[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for MacOS[/p][/*][*][p]Game icons and visuals updated to reflect the new Soulbound Legacy branding[/p][/*][*][p]Game mode descriptions added[/p][/*][*][p]New Icon appears when you die/fail in Time Attack[/p][/*][*][p]User interface icons added for controller users[/p][/*][*][p]Added Discord Rich Presence[/p][/*][*][p]Added a brief how-to-play section for new players[/p][/*][*][p]Added in-game control scheme for PC & Controllers [/p][/*][*][p]Localised the game's store page [/p][/*][*][p]Added new indicator on the main menu [/p][/*][/list][h2]🐞 Bugs Squashed[/h2][list][*][p]Win Screen now lets you return to the menu or restart[/p][/*][*][p]Controller pause menu is now fully navigable[/p][/*][*][p]Compendium properly displays from main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tile duplication causing extra enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing mouse cursor when using keyboard with a controller plugged in[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced old "How to Play" screen with clearer visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players unable to navigate back from selected menus[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu highlight colour now consistently red[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy spawn issue in new tilesets[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player not moving on game start[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a player in VS mode could possess two enemies simultaneously[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies not giving the player score in survival mode[/p][/*][/list][h2]⚠️ Known Issues[/h2][p]We’re aware of a few lingering bugs and are already working on a small patch to address them shortly. In the meantime, if you run into any additional issues, please let us know![/p][p]💬 We’ve opened a Discussion Page in the Steam Community where our dev team will be actively reading and responding to feedback. 

Thanks for helping us make Soulbound Legacy even better!  And that’s everything! Soulbound wouldn’t be the same without this update and this update wouldn’t have happened without you, so from Schmooving Studios and the rest of the Soulbound team, thank you!!!  

Thanks again for all your support!

-The Dink Team[/p]
